root.label: The algorithm library
root.note: Loops with contracts over half-open iterator ranges; every requirement is a precondition.

children.label: Contract basics
children.note: Algorithms see iterators, never containers, so they cannot change a container's size.

children.label: Half-open ranges
children.note: [first, last) includes first, excludes last; not found is reported as last.

children.label: Parameter names
children.note: ForwardIterator or RandomAccessIterator in a signature states the required category.

children.label: Predicates may be copied
children.note: Function objects can be copied freely, so state inside them may split across copies.

children.label: No modifying predicates
children.note: A predicate must not modify elements through the iterator it is given.

children.label: remove and unique
children.note: Shift kept elements forward and return the new logical end.

children.label: Erase-remove idiom
children.note: Call erase(result, end); C++20 std::erase_if does both steps.

children.label: Tail state
children.note: Elements past the returned iterator are valid but unspecified.

children.label: Adjacent only
children.note: unique collapses runs of equal neighbours; sort first to remove all duplicates.

children.label: Copy and overlap
children.note: Overlap rules are preconditions; breaking them is undefined behavior.

children.label: copy
children.note: Destination start must not lie in [first, last).

children.label: copy_backward
children.note: For overlap to the right; d_last must not lie in (first, last].

children.label: transform in place
children.note: Output may equal an input iterator exactly, by explicit remark.

children.label: Sorting and searching
children.note: All need a strict weak ordering; searches need correctly ordered input.

children.label: sort
children.note: Unstable, worst-case O(N log N) comparisons since C++11.

children.label: stable_sort
children.note: Keeps equivalent elements in order; N log squared N without a buffer.

children.label: Binary searches
children.note: Need the range partitioned with respect to the value, not fully sorted.

children.label: Same comparator
children.note: Searching with a different ordering than the sort violates the precondition.

children.label: Partitions and heaps
children.note: Linear-time reordering and the max-heap behind priority_queue.

children.label: partition
children.note: Unstable; stable_partition keeps order at the cost of memory or N log N swaps.

children.label: partition_point
children.note: Binary search for the boundary of an already partitioned range.

children.label: pop_heap
children.note: Moves the largest element to the back; the container must still pop it.

children.label: ranges:: versions
children.note: Constrained function objects added in C++20.

children.label: Concept checks
children.note: ranges::sort on a list fails at the call, not deep inside the library.

children.label: Projections
children.note: A callable applied to each element first, such as &Person::age.

children.label: Return types
children.note: copy gives in_out_result, remove gives a subrange, sort gives the end.

children.label: Not found by ADL
children.note: They are objects, so no ADL and no explicit template arguments.
